fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on alleged police brutality in Miami, including discussion of the Charles Haynes case and responses reported in local newspapers. Additional pieces address municipal concerns such as funding for public libraries and the Community Chest, and discuss prohibition enforcement and federal court proceedings involving coast guardsmen. The issue also contains local Miami and Miami Beach items (including a planned marine pageant/regatta route from the Miami River to the causeway and Miami Beach), society/entertainment notices, sports coverage (boxing), and extensive local advertising.
